prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Input image 1: paper-object/style reference only; replace Paris with the new city. Input image 2: supporting city-scene reference; do not copy ticket layout.
Tactile mid-century travel-poster screen print; flat layered shapes, fine risograph grain and soft paper fibres. Calm, elegant, original artwork in Travary's navy/teal/coral/sage/mustard/warm-cream family. Never photographic. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, readable signs, logos, watermarks, flags, faces or copyrighted characters. Famous architecture sits within a balanced city view, not an oversized isolated object. Exclude real theme-park attractions, Hollywood sign, Space Needle, Cloud Gate and casino buildings. All market panels and shopfronts are unlettered abstract colour blocks. No signboards, plaques or inscriptions. All vehicle plates blank.
City: Milan. Scene: an original Gothic cathedral's spires, not an exact copy of a real cathedral, a glass-roofed arcade, an unmarked tram, abstract fashion-window colour. Light: warm pale-gold late afternoon. Palette: deep navy, soft teal, warm cream, coral, sage and tram mustard. Same light, landmarks and palette as supporting city card. Absolutely no flags, flagpoles, lettering or vehicle/boat markings.
One landscape 3:2 vintage postcard exactly 1536 × 1024 PNG. Thin deckled warm-cream paper edge, faint contact shadow, centred and straight on with genuine alpha outside. Main city subjects in LEFT 60%; RIGHT 35% quiet, especially upper right. No presentation backdrop, tags, postmarks, stamps or UI.
Use original imagined Gothic architecture with altered façade proportions and spire rhythm, never a literal copy. The tram has entirely plain body panels, no words or numbers. Fashion windows show only abstract fabric colours without lettering.
